# Attention Buddy

> A small native macOS app that shows a floating, draggable Claude Code mascot. It watches every Claude Code session through hooks and turns red, blinks, jumps and waves when a session needs the user (an approval, a question or MCP input), turns green when a turn is done, and stays calm while Claude works. It can be put to sleep (grey and silent) for 15 minutes up to the rest of the day from a slider in its session card. Silent, no network access, stores no prompt or code content. Drag it anywhere, hover or click it for a card listing every session and click one to open it in the Claude desktop app, and resize the icon (1× to 4×) and the card (1× to 2×) in Settings (right-click menu). MIT licensed; not affiliated with Anthropic.

Install with one of: the Claude Code plugin (`/plugin marketplace add zahorovskyi/attention-buddy`), Homebrew (`brew install zahorovskyi/tap/attention-buddy`), or the install script. Requires macOS 13+, the Xcode Command Line Tools and jq. Verify with `attention-buddy doctor`.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zahorovskyi/attention-buddy/main/README.md): what it is, states, install, update and uninstall per method, usage, what it changes, troubleshooting
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zahorovskyi/attention-buddy/main/AGENTS.md): how an agent should explain, install, verify and uninstall it, and how to work on the code
- [Design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zahorovskyi/attention-buddy/main/docs/DESIGN.md): architecture, hook events, state rules, animations, install methods, decisions and limits

## Source

- [Hook script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zahorovskyi/attention-buddy/main/hooks/attention-buddy-hook.sh): turns Claude Code hook events into per-session state files
- [Installer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zahorovskyi/attention-buddy/main/install.sh): one-line and clone install, uninstall, hooks setup
- [Plugin manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zahorovskyi/attention-buddy/main/.claude-plugin/plugin.json): Claude Code plugin definition
